text:
annika: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: we need an action tracker for rollout safety improvements: infra hard-caps, auto-rollback hysteresis, a small sim harness, and ops runbook updates.
ravi: +1. I'll own infra hard-caps. Plan: enforce a router-level hard_cap and emit audit headers when a request is rejected.
sam: I'll take auto-rollback rules and tests. Proposal: require two signals (error_rate > 1% over 60s AND p95 > baseline * 1.25) sustained for 90s before triggering. Also exponential backoff on re-open attempts.
lee: I'll build a tiny sim harness that can sweep sample_rate, latency injection, and error injection. Output will be CSV + short summary that maps to rollback triggers.
rollout-bot: system: Task TASK-6120 created: implement rollout hard cap assigned to ravi.
annika: Owners & deadlines: ravi (router hard-cap + audit) PR by Tue 04/21; sam (rollback RFC + tests) PR by Thu 04/23; lee (sim harness + staging job) PR by Mon 04/27.
ravi: Implementation note: router will return 429 and X-Rollout-Audit header when exceeding hard_cap. Example config:
```
rollout:
  hard_cap_percent: 1
  hard_enforce: true
```
sam: For safety, require a stable fallback route. On auto-rollback we switch traffic to stable and page SRE. Tests should assert that traffic returns to stable and alerts fire.
lee: Sim command sketch:
```
python tools/sim_rollout.py --config sim/blast.yaml --sweep sample_rate,latency,error --seed 42 --out results/scan.csv
```
annika: Ops playbook items: 1) Triage flow when auto-rollback triggers 2) Who to page 3) How to re-open quarantined rollout 4) Post-rollback diagnostic checklist. Assigning aj to edit the runbook.
ravi: Will add audit tags (rollout.id, flag.name, region, owner) so nightly scanner can group correlated rollouts.
sam: Also recommend a soft default: max_canary_percent=0.5% for new flags and quarantine_timer=5m. We can expose console slider but limit by infra hard_cap. Overrides require 2 approvers and write reason to audit.
lee: I'll add deterministic seeding so CI sims are reproducible and wire the sim job to run in staging before merges.
annika: Let's schedule a dry-run in staging after PRs merge. Tentative: staging dry-run Thu 04/30 10:00 PDT. Lee/Sam/Ravi please join.
rollout-bot: reminder: oncall rota updated.
ravi: starting branch "router/rollout-hard-cap" now, will link PR here when ready.
sam: opening RFC draft today for rollback rules, will link tests once I have them.
lee: ack 1: sim harness initial commit coming this week.
annika: Great work. Ping here with PR links. We'll review in next eng-platform sync. :white_check_mark:
